summary: P1 1.5 Remote DJ dashboard follow-up -- remove the standalone Remote Link badge and place action plus overall link state in the existing fixed-size, two-line Connect/Disconnect button. The presentation covers Offline, Negotiating, Initializing, Good, Fair, Poor, and B1/B1.1-authoritative Reconnecting without shifting adjacent controls. Direction-specific B2 telemetry and all classifier, recovery, gate/PTT, signaling, and audio behavior remain unchanged.
